takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **52%** of 233 plays (n=122); also Wide (outside) 47% (n=110).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **12.2 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (deeper) (n=232, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Slot (52%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (11.1 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
